summary_en: This phase 2 study tests mifomelatide (TCMCB07) against placebo in adults with newly diagnosed, advanced, unresectable colorectal cancer or pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma who are starting chemotherapy. The study drug is given as a daily subcutaneous injection at 12.5 mg, 25 mg, or 50 mg, or as placebo, for 12 weeks, with an optional open-label extension of up to 26 more weeks at 25 mg daily. The study is designed to measure effects on weight, body composition and BMI.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara mifomelatida (TCMCB07) con placebo en adultos con cáncer colorrectal o adenocarcinoma ductal de páncreas recién diagnosticado, avanzado e irresecable, que están por iniciar quimioterapia. El medicamento del estudio se administra como inyección subcutánea diaria de 12.5 mg, 25 mg o 50 mg, o como placebo, durante 12 semanas, con una extensión opcional de hasta 26 semanas más con 25 mg diarios sin enmascaramiento. El estudio está diseñado para medir los efectos sobre el peso, la composición corporal y el IMC.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Newly diagnosed, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic colorectal or pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
Starting a listed first-line chemotherapy regimen and ready to receive the second dose.
Able to self-inject daily, or to be injected by a caregiver.
Has evaluable disease by RECIST 1.1 and adequate organ function per listed lab values.
not_for: Receiving second-line or later systemic cancer treatment.
History of bulimia, anorexia, or weight loss surgery such as gastric stapling or bypass.
Chronic use of corticosteroids at 5 mg or more of prednisone equivalent per day.
Known brain or central nervous system metastases.
Pregnancy, lactation, plans to become pregnant, or concurrent participation in another clinical trial.
